integrity: The theorem has a self-contained symbolic proof. A small exhaustive checker verifies only the two-color triangle-Ramsey calibration and the k=0,1 endpoint specializations.
scientific_limitations: The exact endpoint is expressed through multicolor triangle Ramsey numbers, is restricted to one symmetric irreflexive ternary relation with exactly three universal variables, and does not classify all spectra below the ceiling.
title: Sharp three-universal cutoff for Bernays–Schönfinkel triple-system spectra
